title: Resistance, flight, breach of arrest, and escape.
bodyHtml:
[§124B-142]  Resistance, flight, breach of arrest, and escape.  Any person subject to this chapter who:

     (1)  Resists apprehension;

     (2)  Flees from apprehension;

     (3)  Breaks arrest; or

     (4)  Escapes from custody or confinement,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
